module: Deterministic pseudo-random draw for editor tools: from a seed, a salt that distinguishes several decisions at the same address, and up to five numbers (a to e) that say "where" (volume, floor, piece index...), always returns the same value. Useful for reproducible variations (jitter) without state.
usage:
local r = editor_toolUtilities_dice.roll(seed, 1, floor, bay)
local j = editor_toolUtilities_dice.spread(seed, 2, floor, bay)
notes: Missing slots a to e (nil) count as zero, as do seed and salt.
The computation is modulo 2147483647; the result is in [0,1).

roll.desc: Deterministic draw in [0,1) for the address (seed, salt, a..e).

salt.desc: Salt distinguishing the decisions of a same address

spread.desc: Same draw as roll, brought to the interval -1..1 (deviation in either direction, handy for jitter).
